style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: in every beat he scuttles or flips, or the crab or the jar crosses the whole frame; he never holds a pose; new shot size and camera move every beat; his claws snap in speech too
character: a glossy red lobster, long whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug and pleased with himself
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, hauling coins and the jar at the lens all clip, never still
props: ONE wooden table; ONE glass jar of yellow butter with a lid; ONE stack of coins; ONE lemon; ONE tight paper scroll, red wax seal, a printed FISH and nothing else; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the jar is in frame all clip; the butter is inside it until 1.55 and smeared on him after; the scroll hides behind HIS OWN antenna until 8.55, then stays in his claw
environment: a sunlit seaside kitchen, tall window, white tiles

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smug, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: BAN-ke, TOL-ka MAS-lom, YES-li, in-ves-TEE-ruy, v ye-DU, never YE-du
audio.pacing: 0.9-3.1 one breath; one pause only, 3.1-3.8; 3.8-6.45 one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: glass clink, butter squelch, claw snaps, coins spilling, paper unrolling at 8.55, a wet bite at 9.6

timeline.a: a red claw sweeps across the lens and clears it
he vaults onto the table and the coin stack bursts apart
he rears up on his tail, both claws thrown wide, the crab leaning in
he dives head first into the butter jar, it rocks and skids
he bursts out glazed yellow, butter flinging past the lens
the crab hauls the jar across the whole frame and drops it
he scuttles at the lens till he fills the frame
he stabs the big claw at the lens and snaps it shut
he flips onto his back and spins the lemon on both claws
he cracks the lemon and the juice sprays past the lens
he rakes the whole coin stack into the jar and slams the lid
the crab climbs the jar, slips, and rides it across the frame
he walks the jar at the lens on his tail, antennae lashing it
he rips the sealed scroll from behind HIS OWN antenna on the run and slings it left to right, the seal snapping off, the paper unrolling across the frame
timeline.c: low track, whip with the paper

timeline.a: he drives right to left at the lens, dunks the paper into the butter and bites a piece out of it, chewing deadpan, filling the frame
timeline.c: big close, never on the eye

must_appear: the crab hauling coins at the lens, he dives into the jar at 1.55 and bursts out glazed, he scuttles at the lens, coins into the jar, the scroll out from behind his antenna at 8.55, the paper dunked in butter and bitten at 9.6
